task: If I start using Copilot Individual, how much US dollars will it cost per year and what features does it have?
answer: GitHub Copilot Individual costs $100 USD per year (listed on GitHub's official Copilot plans page as $10 USD per month or $100 USD per year). Its features include: unlimited messages and interactions; context-aware coding support and explanations; debugging and security remediation assistance; access to knowledge from top open source repositories; generate tests/docs with slash commands; web search powered by Bing; explain failed Actions jobs; answers about issues/PRs/discussions/files/commits; multi-file editing in VS Code; switch between models; real-time code suggestions; comments to code; tailor chat to your private codebase; unlimited Copilot Extensions integrations; build private extensions; custom instructions; inline chat and prompt suggestions; slash commands and context variables; commit message generation; PR/issue/discussion summaries; code feedback in VS Code; Quick Info explanations in Visual Studio; debug assistant in Visual Studio; Java upgrade assistant; code review in GitHub; Copilot Workspace for PRs; support across editors/IDEs, GitHub.com and mobile, GitHub CLI and Windows Terminal; and a public code filter with code referencing. (Note: GitHub's current live plans page rebranded the individual tier as Copilot Pro at $10/month and no longer displays an annual figure, so the $100 USD/year price is taken from GitHub's official archived Copilot plans page.)
